user.title: Taipower bill tracking
user.description: One entry per meter. Enter the initial meter-read date printed on your bill. After that, meter reads are kept as a list (via the close button or the services); this value is only used the first time the list is created.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure
reconfigure.description: The meter-read list is the only source of truth; if it is wrong, fix it with the set_last_read_date / update_reading services, or re-enter the initial date here and tick the box below to clear the history. A wrong initial date (e.g. the Close period button pressed a few extra times) pushes the period window into the future and blanks every value; tick the box below to also drop the bad history rows.

error.source_required: Pick at least one kWh source in statistics mode
error.last_read_invalid: That date could not be parsed
error.last_read_in_future: The previous meter-read date cannot be in the future — use the past date printed on your bill
error.last_read_too_old: The previous meter-read date is more than 400 days ago — check the year
error.cycle_days_too_short: The read interval must be at least 20 days (bimonthly bills are usually 60)
error.cycle_days_invalid: The read interval must be a number

init.title: Tariff and surcharges
init.description: Verify against a real bill. Surcharges (renewable energy fee, air pollution fee) and business tax default to 0.

data.notify_targets: Push the close confirmation to these devices (multi-select; empty = no push)

data_description.notify_targets: Only the official Home Assistant app renders the confirmation buttons; core notifications (persistent_notification) cannot carry actions in 2026.10. Empty = no push notification.

options.manual: Key in the meter reading from the bill
